name: Squall Hammer
description: Stand with the weight poised forward and the pistol arm low, ready to rise on the first beat.

name: Pulsar Frizzen
description: Bring the pistol from rest to level in one flat motion and fire before the foe has set.

name: Squall Cylinder
description: Turn the barrel outward like a folding wing to knock a thrust off the line of the body.

name: Deluge Muzzle
description: Hang light on the feet for a breath, then lunge a full stride in as the foe commits.

name: Triumphant Foresight
description: Run a fine thread of qi down the arm and into the bore before the first shot is loosed.

name: Lordly Hipshot
description: Brush the pan with the faintest qi spark so the priming lights with no visible flash.

name: Muzzleseal
description: Fire wide while a sharp qi cry splits the foe's attention, then step into the opening.

name: Pistolgrip Edict
description: Lower the barrel like a stooping talon and drive a qi-packed ball through the foe's guard.

name: Lanyardring Triumph
description: Retreat beneath the shadow of a raised arm, firing as the foe overreaches the gap.

name: Vacuum Barrel
description: Hold all the qi of the school in the bore and loose a single shot that ends the exchange.

name: Triumphant Triggerbar
description: The school's own opening move: the whole discipline gathered into the first shot, so one qi-wrapped ball decides the exchange.

name: Feather Snapfire
description: Walk the road at an even pace with the pistol held low and the eyes sweeping the verges.

name: Quickdraw Banner
description: Lay the pistol arm on a waystone's top and take one slow shot at a foe on the road.

name: Immaculate Triggerbar
description: Turn the shoulder into the road dust and cover the face with the sleeve against a blow.

name: Revelation Flashpan
description: Slow at each bend and read the verge for flattened grass, still birds or a waiting body.

name: Delugebarrel
description: Set each foot in the hard ridge between cart ruts and keep the pistol arm steady over uneven ground.

name: Radiance Report
description: Steady the barrel on a fence rail and let a thread of qi settle the arm before firing.

name: Thumbback Vow
description: Fire into the road to raise a plume of dust and powder smoke that hides the shooter's flank.

name: Bedrock Pointblank
description: Run behind a fleeing foe along the road, firing in measured bursts to keep him from turning.

name: Thunderclap Quickdraw
description: Wait at the last bend with qi gathered and loose one shot at the foe the moment he rounds it.

name: Destiny Barrel
description: The school's own move: walking, resting, firing and pursuing as one patient sequence that never loses the foe on the road.

name: Hammergift
description: Count the left and right beats under the breath and keep the whole body to their time.

name: Peal Hipshot
description: Draw the right pistol along the line from hip to mark and fire at the end of the stroke.

name: Pistolgrip Vow
description: Step on the beat to put the shoulder before a strike, the barrel covering the throat.

name: Squall Snapfire
description: Raise the left pistol on the off beat and fire it between the reports of the right.

name: Pulsarmuzzle
description: Fire both pistols from the hip on two beats so close they sound almost as one.

name: Entropy Hammer
description: Break the cadence with one late motion so the foe moves early into the waiting barrel.

name: Skyborne Thumbback
description: Take a long stride on the beat to the nearest cover while the second pistol still covers the foe.

name: Prismpistol
description: Reload one pistol in the beats while the other keeps its barrel on the line.

name: Prismhammer
description: Fire both pistols on a held beat so two qi-wrapped balls strike the same point of plate.

name: Gloom Report
description: Gather the beats, then break them into a sudden fan of fire that closes every line open to the foe.

name: Unrivaled Lanyardring
description: Hold the line of sight through a long exchange, firing in paired beats that never let the foe cross it.

name: Harmonious Muzzle
description: The school's own move: left, right and step bound into one unbroken cadence that gives the foe no beat to enter.

name: Hammerboon
description: Stand with one foot on each side of an imagined stream and keep the weight even.

name: Pealreport
description: Crouch on the pebbled bank and rest both wrists on the knees to fire a clean shot.

name: Parity Cylinder
description: Swing both barrels in a small eddying circle to carry a cut harmlessly past the body.

name: Noble Frizzen
description: Draw the two pistols across each other so their lines meet at one point before the foe.

name: Gloomhammer
description: Sweep the two barrels apart then together across the foe's front to pin him between them.

name: Silken Muzzle
description: Step behind the powder smoke as it rises like river mist and reappear at the foe's side.

name: Inferno Pointblank
description: Charge and ram a pistol in the rushing rhythm of rapids, hands never pausing.

name: Hammertriumph
description: Drop both pistols together like a falling cascade and send twin balls through the foe's guard.

name: Lanyardring Verdict
description: Curl back like a backwater and fire the instant the foe's rush has passed.

name: Season Flashpan
description: Send two separate lines of fire round the foe and join them at his back in a single surge.

name: Peerless Snapfire
description: The school's own move: two streams of qi-driven fire that part around the foe and meet again behind him.

name: Pistolboon
description: Open the arms to full spread with the feet wide, the chest low and the pistol lifted.

name: Sovereign Pointblank
description: Lift the eye to a high sight line and fire downward along it onto the mark.

name: Enshrined Pistolgrip
description: Sweep the barrel upward from below to carry an overhead blow clear of the head.

name: Pealbarrel
description: Circle slowly and take in the whole field at once, marking each foe's weight and weapon.

name: Vigor Flashpan
description: Fold the arms in and drop forward in a quick dive step that closes the foe's distance.

name: Paramount Report
description: Fire along the outer edge of the foe's guard so the ball clips the arm raised to cover him.

name: Destiny Cylinder
description: Dive in with a shot, rake the butt across the guard and fire again from the opened line.

name: Volition Thumbback
description: Gather qi, then loose a fan of shots whose pattern falls across the field like a hawk's shadow.

name: Barreledict
description: Hold the qi field and the stare on one foe until a single shot can pierce anything between.

name: Sovereign Quickdraw
description: The school's own move: every art of the hawk gathered into one cast shot that falls from above like a stoop.

name: Reportdecree
description: Draw the pistol on a breath taken down into the Core and fire on the exhale.

name: Triggerbar Banner
description: Hold the hammer at full cock with one hand while the other braces the aim.

name: Deluge Foresight
description: Sink the weight into the hips and let the Core steady every limb for the shot.

name: Hammerpledge
description: Turn the barrel across the body with the Core's pulse behind it to throw a blade aside.

name: Prism Frizzen
description: Seed the powder charge with a measured pulse from the Core so it burns in perfect time.

name: Peal Hammer
description: Link the powder track and the qi track at the hammer's fall so both fire as one.

name: Barrel Reliquary
description: Move the barrel in a slow, calm orbit round the foe so every guard he tries is turned.

name: Vigor Foresight
description: Weave back along two crossing tracks of footwork so the foe cannot follow either line.

name: Vacuum Quickdraw
description: Drive a ball along a track of Core qi so it bores through plate and shield together.

name: Statute Lanyardring
description: Cast two linked pulses of qi through the barrel and loose a volley that holds a whole line.

name: Reportbanner
description: Align the Core's pulse with the powder's burn so the shot leaves the barrel as one clean blow.

name: Steel Barrel
description: The school's own move: powder and Core qi loosed as two tracks of one shot that no cover turns aside.
